title: Surface distance versus score movement (available pairs; exploratory)
research_question: Do larger surface changes accompany larger score changes?
filters: all approved available non-C0 pairs; exploratory association because primary complete cohort is empty
main_observation: 42 model-variant observations have surface distance; missing distances are omitted from marks.
allowed_interpretation: The plot describes association, with repeated observations belonging to frames. When the primary cohort is empty, these are explicitly exploratory available-pair observations.
forbidden_interpretation: Association is not causation; surface distance is not semantic distance. Available-pair observations are not complete-cohort inference.
